desc: Settle the algorithm choice: analyze BFS worst-case (cycle C_n antipodal, lollipop with corridor length ~N/2) to decide if implicit pair-BFS fits in time; if not, commit to the structural formula approach.

Derive the complete structural theory: feasibility conditions and min-move formula covering (a) S,T in different branches of a degree≥3 bay (cost 2d+2), (b) S,T nested on a corridor needing a cycle bay (cost 2·(dS(bay)+dT(bay)) + cycle pass cost), (c) S,T on the cycle itself (cost ~ cycle length), (d) path graph => -1; validate against sample 1 (3), sample 2 (-1), sample 3 (4), star (6), lollipop (10), T-junction (-1), C4 adjacent (4).

Build a brute-force cross-check harness: generate all simple connected graphs with N ≤ 7, all (S,T) pairs, run pair-BFS as oracle, and dump answers; use it to (1) extract the exact feasibility criterion (compare against "not a path" and block-cut-tree-based criteria) and (2) fit the cycle-bay pass cost for general cycle length k by testing cycle+corridor gadgets of size ≤ 12.

Derive and verify the exact feasibility criterion via the block-cut tree against the oracle data: swap possible iff graph is not a path AND (S,T in same cyclic biconnected component OR an articulation vertex with a usable third branch lies on the S–T path OR a cycle bay is reachable from the corridor); confirm the T-junction-style impossibility cases precisely.

Derive the exact cycle-bay pass cost for general k (on-cycle case and corridor-attached case) by fitting oracle data, then express the full min-move formula: min over usable bays b of 2·(dist(S,b)+dist(T,b)) + pass_cost(b), with pass_cost ∈ {0 (vertex-disjoint paths), 1 (d=1 common neighbor), 2 (distinct-branch vertex bay), k-dependent (cycle bay)}.
Implement the validated formula-based solution: iterative Tarjan bridges + bridge tree, BFS distance arrays from S and T, bay enumeration, min-cost computation, -1 handling; O(N+M).
Validate the formula implementation against the pair-BFS oracle on ALL small graphs (N ≤ 7) and on random larger graphs (N ≤ 14) with pair-BFS as oracle; only then finalize.
Test final solution against the three samples plus edge cases (N=2, path, star, complete graph, cycle, lollipop, T-junction) and confirm complexity O(N+M).
